subject: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement — proposed procurement flow and co-sell steps for Helio Inc.
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Patel <anya.patel@helio.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Jul 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement — next steps for Helio Inc.

Hi Anya —

Great to meet earlier this week. Helio's use case for AI-assisted customer insights maps well to our GCP Marketplace listing + co-sell motion. To keep timelines tight for a Q4 pilot, I want to align on the procurement and listing steps that typically block customers.

Quick asks to unblock:
- Who is the formal procurement contact and preferred PO flow at Helio? (email for AP team)
- Any billing constraints (net terms, PO template, billing entity)?
- Are you able to accept a marketplace subscription billed by Google, or do you require a vendor invoice?

I've attached a draft mutual action plan and a short spreadsheet with the minimal procurement artifacts we usually need for GCP listing. If you confirm procurement contact and timing, I can loop in the GCP catalog team and Marissa to kick off listing intake.

Attachments: redwood_gcp_map_v1.xlsx; SOW_redwood_helio_draft.pdf

Thanks —
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193
Redwood Inference

From: GCP Marketplace Onboarding <gcp-catalog@google.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Anya Patel <anya.patel@helio.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement — next steps for Helio Inc.

Hi Camila / Anya —

Thanks for the note. To progress a listing intake we need the following from the vendor and the customer procurement side:
1) Vendor listing owner (Camila, Marissa or other) + contact.
2) Customer procurement contact + PO process (will customer push a PO through Google Marketplace or require vendor invoicing).
3) Minimal SOW and pricing SKU definitions (we can accept the spreadsheet you attached).
4) Compliance evidence (SOC2 type II report URL or evidence schedule) — can be provided via secure link.

If Helio is open to using Google-managed billing for the subscription, the procurement step is usually faster (PO to Google). Otherwise we'll need a vendor invoice flow which can add 2–4 weeks.

Happy to schedule a short intake call next week.

Best,
GCP Marketplace Onboarding Team
[Attachment: GCP_onboarding_checklist.pdf]
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 3 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing & procurement — internal: proposed procurement workflow

Camila / Jonas —

Thanks — I reviewed the spreadsheet. Proposed pickup plan (internal):

1) Confirm Helio procurement contact (Camila to confirm).
2) Prepare two commercial tracks in parallel:
   - Marketplace-billed subscription (fast track): prepare SKU mapping and marketplace pricing stub.
   - Vendor-invoice flow (fallback): prepare vendor invoice template + PR/PO acceptance terms.
3) Prepare minimal compliance pack: SOC2 letter + IP/data processing summary (we have a recent SOC2 digest).
4) Mutual Action Plan (MAP): include milestones for listing intake, catalog review, security review, procurement signoff, and go-live.
5) Coordinate internal CS/Sales Engineering (Jonas) to prepare a demo slot for GCP catalog review.

I've drafted a MAP and attached it (redwood_gcp_map_v1.xlsx). Also included draft SOW for Helio to review.

Notes: if Helio requires longer payment terms, we should capture that ASAP — it affects whether they can move through Marketplace billing.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Director, Cloud Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Patel <anya.patel@helio.com>, procurement@helio.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual Action Plan + procurement options (Helio pilot)

Hi Anya / Helio procurement team —

Thanks for the quick replies. Per the GCP checklist below, I'm attaching our mutual action plan (MAP) and a short SOW to make procurement easier. Two options for Helio:

Option A — Marketplace-billed (recommended):
- Helio approves SKU and signs off via PO to Google.
- Fast: typically 1–2 weeks after PO receipt.
- Billing: Google invoices Helio; Redwood receives settlement from Google.

Option B — Vendor invoice (backup):
- Helio issues PO to Redwood; Redwood invoices per SOW milestones.
- May require vendor onboarding forms and tax docs; add 2–4 weeks.

Action items for Helio:
- Please confirm which option you prefer.
- If Option B, please upload your PO template or draft.
- Billing contact to loop in (name + email).

I've also included a DocuSign link for a minimal SOW if you'd prefer to sign that route: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/ABCDEF123456

Attachments: redwood_gcp_map_v1.xlsx; SOW_redwood_helio_draft.pdf

Looking forward — happy to jump on a 20-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila_reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Anya Patel <anya.patel@helio.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@helio.com, GCP Marketplace Onboarding <gcp-catalog@google.com>
Date: Thu, 8 Jul 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual Action Plan + procurement options (Helio pilot)

Camila / team —

Thanks — Helio prefers Option A (Marketplace-billed) to avoid additional vendor onboarding. Procurement has confirmed they can issue a PO to Google for the subscription. I've attached a signed PO reference (Helio_PO_000789.pdf) and confirmed billing contact below.

Billing contact: Priya Kumar <priya.kumar@helio.com>
Estimated PO issue date: 2026-07-12 (we'll upload to Google Marketplace once issued).

We reviewed the SOW at a high level and are OK with the minimal SOW for pilot; procurement will follow up with a copy of the PO once it's uploaded. Please let us know any final SKU naming we should expect in the Google invoice to ensure AP reconciliation.

Thanks,
Anya Patel
Head of Procurement | Helio Inc.
[Attachment: Helio_PO_000789.pdf]
